picks.excerpt: Official-looking renders of Samsung's Galaxy Z Flip 8, Z Fold 8, Watch 9 and Watch Ultra 2 leaked ahead of the July 22 Unpacked, giving the first full look at the Galaxy AI foldable and wearable lineup in its final colors and designs.
picks.rationale: Flagship Galaxy AI lineup revealed in final form days before Unpacked - kept as the single Samsung item over the near-dup Unpacked-date and Watch-9 teasers to maximize device spread.

picks.excerpt: Meta is patching its Ray-Ban AI glasses to disable the camera if the recording LED is tampered with, after a modding scene sold LED-kill services - reigniting the debate over whether cameraless AI glasses are the safer design future.
picks.rationale: Distinct from the published Meta 'super-sensing' story; TechRadar's cameraless-design framing is the more actionable angle for designers weighing privacy-first AI wearables. Kept over the near-dup Android Authority version.

picks.excerpt: A hands-on review of Google's first ground-up Gemini smart speaker - the $99 Home Speaker with a dedicated NPU for on-device AI processing, 360-degree audio and Gemini-driven conversational control of the home.
picks.rationale: Shipping, buy-decision review of Google's first ground-up Gemini speaker with an on-device NPU - concrete on-device AI hardware, distinct outlet and device category.

picks.excerpt: Roborock's Saros 20 uses AI object recognition to identify and dodge 300+ obstacle types, plus solid-state lidar and a climbing chassis - a review of how far on-device AI has pushed robot-vacuum autonomy in 2026.
picks.rationale: Fresh review showing how far on-device AI vision has pushed robot-vacuum autonomy; different brand and product class from the published iRobot Roomba story.

picks.excerpt: Microsoft's 2026 Surface Laptop 13.8 gets Qualcomm's new Snapdragon X2 Plus, delivering a big NPU/CPU jump for Copilot+ on-device AI - a review of what the next-gen Arm silicon means for AI PC performance.
picks.rationale: AI-PC silicon benchmark that shifts device recommendations; distinct from the published Surface Pro OLED / X2 Elite review (different device and chip tier).
